diagnoses.analysis: The required-status-check is an aggregate gate, not an independent build failure: .github/workflows/reusable-pr-build.yml:62-89 fails when needs.common.result is not success. Frozen evidence contains exactly two failed common smoke jobs and 67 passed checks. Both failed smoke jobs have the same PR-attributable missing thread.id assertion. The shared Spring Boot opt-in fix resolves the upstream cause; no workflow changes are warranted.

All six failed SpringBootAotSmokeTest executions report missing thread.id at AbstractSpringBootSmokeTest.java:39. The PR intentionally changes otel.javaagent.add-thread-details to default false, but the shared smoke setup still expects both thread attributes without enabling them. Add OTEL_JAVAAGENT_ADD_THREAD_DETAILS=true in AbstractSpringBootSmokeTest.configure; SpringBootAotSmokeTest calls super.configure, so the real-agent AOT coverage retains its existing thread assertions without reverting the production default.

Related to #20510 — group 11 only.

Makes process command resource attributes and Java agent thread details default-off independently of `otel.instrumentation.common.v3-preview`. Explicit opt-ins and opt-outs remain supported.

- **Defaults:** Gate process command attributes solely on their dedicated setting; align flat thread-detail defaults with declarative distribution behavior. Preserve other process attributes.
- **Coverage:** Test absent, enabled, and disabled flat settings; consolidate obsolete process preview cases.
- **Documentation:** Update resource usage, metadata, and breaking-change migration notes.

To retain capture:

```properties
otel.instrumentation.resources.experimental.process-command-attributes.enabled=true
otel.javaagent.add-thread-details=true
```

No unrelated selectors, instrumentation names, or shared preview helpers change.
